Subject: Redwood Inference - Post-call recap & next steps

Hi Aisha / Ravi —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Goal: validate Redwood can meet Finexa's security, procurement, and data retention requirements to move to a pilot.
- Key decision criteria you called out: SOC 2 Type II, recent pen test, audit log access, and a clear data retention / deletion policy. Pricing/commitment are secondary to security clearance for this project.

Agreed next steps (open):
1) We will upload SOC 2 + pen test artifacts and a short audit-logs sample by EOD Friday (6/11).
2) You will confirm the procurement timeline and share the name of the economic buyer / contract owner.
3) We'll map stakeholders (security, legal, procurement, engineering) and propose a short mutual-action plan.

I copied Marissa (legal/contracts) and Dylan (solutions/security) to lead evidence delivery and stakeholder mapping. Marissa — can you track deliveries and drop a Drive link when uploaded?

If that looks right, I’ll update the M.A.P and follow up with a 30-minute sync next week.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Thanks Ben — that matches our notes. A few quick clarifications before you upload: 

- Can you confirm the SOC 2 scope (in-scope services and systems)? We need to validate the systems that handle customer data.
- Do you have a public summary of the pen test (high-level findings) before we share internally?
- For audit logs, we need an example schema and retention window (how long logs are kept, and how they are purged).

Procurement: we’re targeting an internal review the week of 6/21. I’m looping Ravi (legal/procurement) — Ravi, can you confirm if Finexa needs any additional contract language (data-processing addendum, encryption clauses) to start the SOW review?

Thanks — Aisha

Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Security evidence delivery (questions)

Thanks for the uploads — I reviewed the high-level docs. A couple of items where we need a bit more detail before security sign-off: 

1) Audit logs: can you confirm the retention configurable windows (e.g., 90/180/365 days) and whether Finexa can export raw logs on demand? The sample schema looks good; we need a short note on retention policy enforcement.
2) Data deletion: your policy describes deletion flow but can you confirm whether the KV cache is deleted on tenant termination and what the typical propagation time is?
3) Pen test: would it be possible to redact any customer-identifying information and provide the full report under an NDA? We can sign a one-way NDA if needed.

If possible, can someone from your security/infra team join a 30-minute call on Wed 6/16 at 10am ET to walk through the audit logs and deletion flow?

On the procurement side, Ravi asked for an early draft of the SOW to start internal alignment.

Sofia
Sofia Martinez
Security Lead, Finexa
sofia.martinez@finexa.com
